purpose: Teach: 財閥/縦横/色濃く/ドラッカー/声楽/命がけ/評し/降水

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦前の、本気で、絶対、財閥、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on prewar zaibatsu was genuinely impressive. I was really struck by how thoroughly you handled it.
lines.style: Warm recognition in opening. Steady, measured pace. Genuine appreciation without overstatement. Clear eye contact. Slight lean forward to signal sincerity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古典の、本気で、絶対、縦横、絶対、無尽の、絶対、表現、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I tried to explore the classical expressions of unlimited scope—the horizontal and vertical dimensions—and I'm grateful for the chance to research something so deep.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Warm formality with a thread of real earnestness underneath. Steady delivery, no rushing. Slight pause before 'deep' to show she means it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域の伝統が、本気で、絶対、色濃く、絶対、残る、絶対、街、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: What impressed me was how vividly you captured the regional traditions that remain in those areas. Your perspective was really broad and thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Slightly slower pace. Traces of discovery in her voice—she's appreciating it as she says it. Gentle emphasis on 'broad'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。経営学の、本気で、絶対、ドラッカー、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes—I actually incorporated Drucker's management principles as a framework. The research went much deeper than I expected it would.
lines.style: Modest but confident. Slightly faster than before, energized by the direction of her work. Light emphasis on 'framework' to show the structure. Genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明治期の、本気で、絶対、声楽、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: I noticed you gave real attention to the history of vocal music education during the Meiji period too. That was remarkably sophisticated work.
lines.style: Engaged but unhurried. Warm admiration. Slight lilt of discovery on 'vocal music'—she's noticing the range of Sakura's thinking. Genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先人の、本気で、絶対、命がけ、絶対、の業績、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The pioneers put everything into their work—I wanted to honor that commitment in my research and really understand what they accomplished.
lines.style: Respectful, with quiet intensity. Slower pace on 'everything' to signal weight. Small pause before 'commitment.' Sincere, not formal. Slight warmth underneath the respect.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文芸評論で、本気で、絶対、評し、絶対、た、絶対、本、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And then you actually applied literary criticism to evaluate specific texts in your framework. That was genuinely insightful.
lines.style: Slightly surprised appreciation. Warm recognition. Measured pace. Subtle emphasis on 'actually' and 'insightful'—she's genuinely delighted by the sophistication. Open, engaged tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。気候変動と、本気で、絶対、降水、絶対、パターン、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to look at how climate and precipitation patterns intersect with those historical questions. The research ended up being so much richer for it.
lines.style: Warm closing gratitude. Slight gathering of reflection. Steady pace with a gentle fade at the end. She's showing both the scope of her thinking and genuine thanks. Quiet pride without arrogance.
